plugin.name: NavicoAutopilot
plugin.summary: Control a B&G or Simrad (Navico) autopilot over NMEA 2000
plugin.author: xanderburchartz
plugin.description: Controls a Navico autopilot computer (B&G and Simrad NAC-1/2/3, AC12/42) directly over NMEA 2000: Standby, Auto (heading hold), Wind, Nav, No Drift and course changes of 1 and 10 degrees. Shows the pilot mode, the heading and the target heading or wind angle. Uses the NMEA 2000 connections of OpenCPN itself, so any gateway OpenCPN can transmit through works. Each button press sends one command.
